frames.narration: Checkout wants to charge 25 dollars. It only knows one method: PaymentGateway.pay(dollars).
It calls pay(25) on whatever gateway it was given. Today that happens to be our adapter.
The adapter does the translating. The bank wants whole cents and a currency code, so 25.00 becomes 2500 and USD.
It now calls the legacy library in the way the library expects.
The library answers in its own format: an object with ok and ref.
The adapter translates the answer back into the plain string Checkout understands. Checkout never learned the bank exists.
